name: Bismarck — everlasting17th reconstruction

sources.title: Bismark battleship
sources.author: everlasting17th
sources.usedFor: Original complete geometry, UVs, normals and all embedded PBR textures

sources.title: Bismarck full-hull model and dimensions, Royal Museums Greenwich
sources.usedFor: Approximately 251 m overall length (823 ft), 36 m beam; vessel identity and contemporary configuration reference.

accuracy: Detailed artist reconstruction of Bismarck, not surveyed engineering geometry. Source hull is uniformly scaled to 251 m; source proportions and authored paint waterline are retained, so measured beam, mast height and draft differ from exact historical specifications. Artist equipment fit and paint scheme are not assigned to a precise date. This specific vessel must not substitute for unrelated fictional or historical classes. Native visual review is required before campaign activation.
axes: right-handed: X bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse
author: everlasting17th
sourceRevision: Pinned public Objaverse snapshot; may differ from the current Sketchfab revision
geometrySource: Artist-authored licensed asset; no voxel or generated recognition geometry
modifications: WNT1922 baked static node hierarchy and metre scale, centered the hull, oriented bow +X and up +Y, merged primitives by material without mesh simplification, retained all artist UVs and created 512 px budget derivatives of embedded images, with source and derivative hashes retained, assigned unused planar UVs to untextured rigging, normalized vertex normals, removed Float32-degenerate faces and orientation-unstable microscopic slivers, and repaired normals-disagreeing winding. Native centimetre/int16 precision is checked explicitly; only unstable slivers within eight coordinate ULPs can be discarded. Counts below identify these repairs.

nativePrecision.rule: Drop only collapsed faces or winding-unstable slivers whose altitude is at most eight Float32 position ULPs; robust source winding is corrected, not discarded.
